metar.raw: METAR RCNN 240800Z 35006KT 9999 VCSH SCT008 BKN016 BKN030 25/21 Q1005 NOSIG RMK A2968 VCSH NW

comment.zh-TW: 主因是強風，但數據不支持升級。規則燈因海上颱風警報，把 10/24 14 時至 10/25 08 時列為中。然而機場預報（TAF）平均風僅 12 節，機場觀測（METAR）風 6 節，八個模式全數判低，陣風超過 29 節的機率 14%、超過 49 節的機率 0%，之後各時段也都是低，因此停飛風險評為低。

comment.en: The main cause is strong wind, but the data do not support an upgrade. The rule light rates 10/24 14:00 to 10/25 08:00 as Medium because of the marine typhoon warning. However, the airport forecast (TAF) shows a mean wind of only 12 kt and the airport observation (METAR) shows wind at 6 kt. All eight models rate it Low, with a 14% chance of gusts over 29 kt and a 0% chance of gusts over 49 kt, and every later period is also Low, so the disruption risk is rated Low.

comment.en: The main factor is strong wind/crosswind, but the overall disruption risk is Low. Although 10/24 14:00 to 10/25 08:00 is rated Medium due to the sea typhoon warning and land strong wind advisory, the airport forecast (TAF) shows mean wind of only 4 to 12 kt and crosswind of 0.1 to 0.9 kt. The European model and US model show gusts up to 23.9 kt, the chance of gusts over 29 kt is at most 14%, the chance of gusts over 49 kt is 0%, and all models rate the risk as Low.

Although a sea typhoon warning and a land strong-wind advisory have been in effect since 10/24 14:00, gusts and estimated gusts in all models stay at or below 18.1 kt, and the chance of gusts over 49 kt peaks at 4%, so support for strong wind is weak. Overall rated Medium.

From 10/24 14:00 to 10/25 08:00 local, the official rating is Medium based on the Central Weather Administration sea typhoon warning (Typhoon Champi), though all models show gusts at or below 12.8 kt, with at most a 10% chance of gusts over 29 kt. Additionally, across multiple periods from 10/25 02:00 to 10/29 02:00 local, the US model predicts visibility as low as 46 to 151 m, raising the fog risk to Medium.
